kind: candidate inventory, not a training or evaluation manifest

sources.title: Western Sydney DJI Air 3 field recordings
sources.coverage: Four flight recordings, three capture dates, two sites, one drone model; 24 microphones are views of the same timelines.
sources.duration_evidence: Four selected raw views contain about 5618.27 complete-frame seconds (93.64 minutes), including unlabelled material. Publisher flight-duration claims and explicit ambient spans remain separate from raw duration.
sources.label_support: Flight telemetry and publisher-declared no-drone intervals; no independently audited audible-onset/offset labels.
sources.access: Four fixed-recorder WAV prefixes probed; PCM32/48kHz/six channels. Two March files end with eight incomplete-frame bytes. Released generator inspected statically.
blockers: Released generator does not read or enforce skip_seconds_end; its first negative segment would continue into the second. No paper output was regenerated.
Both March flights share a date/site group and must stay together.
October background annotation remains unsupported; no explicit negative interval in its config.
Two inspected March WAVs have eight trailing bytes beyond complete six-channel frames; a bounded native-frame policy is required.
Single model and too little matched negative exposure for the benchmark.
sources.next_action: Use explicit bounded intervals in our own intake, preserve native precision and first-view identity, validate labels/telemetry, and group the entire March capture together.
sources.disposition: candidate; quality, provenance and duplicate review pending

sources.title: DroneNoise Database v3
sources.coverage: One Edzell field campaign on 2022-08-17; microphone/event names require provenance review.
sources.duration_evidence: 174 WAV headers checked: nine calibration files, 165 other files with 3570 file-seconds. Removing microphone suffixes gives 20 candidate groups; sum of maximum group durations is 430 seconds, not verified unique time.
sources.label_support: Publisher drone-noise measurements; no verified continuous background or audible-event boundaries established.
sources.access: Pinned v3 metadata and 712704 bytes of bounded WAV prefixes retrieved. Full files and MD5s not verified.
blockers: Candidate filename grouping is not an independence/non-overlap proof.
One campaign cannot supply independent-session diversity.
No established matched negative coverage.
sources.next_action: Audit spreadsheet and mic/event identities; stage the chosen view per original event. Keep the whole campaign in one partition.
sources.disposition: candidate; quality, provenance and duplicate review pending

sources.title: IDMT Berne 2022
sources.coverage: Publisher: eight flights, three model families, one Berne campaign; static, linear and random flight, eight-microphone array.
sources.duration_evidence: 163 real WAV members after excluding macOS resource forks; directory sizes and one verified 30-second header suggest81.5 file-minutes, versus publisher approximate106. All-header/timing verification remains incomplete.
sources.label_support: Drone position/azimuth metadata; flight presence is not an audible-event annotation.
sources.access: ZIP central directory and one WAV prefix inspected. Complete header/CSV inspection hit HTTP429 and stopped; whole archive not transferred.
blockers: Excerpts must be joined by original flight/campaign, not randomly split.
No verified drone-absent benchmark hours established.
sources.next_action: Use cached, serialized inspection or full cloud intake; verify every header and timing across source-part suffixes before reconstructing the eight candidate flight roots from one capture day.
sources.disposition: candidate; quality, provenance and duplicate review pending

sources.title: Polish UAV/speech field recordings
sources.coverage: Datasheet: 17 UAV units (repeated models), four locations, five date/site combinations, two recording-device types; hovering measurement grid plus operator speech.
sources.duration_evidence: 19 distribution files, 12045473772 bytes; no measured unique hours.
sources.label_support: Measurement-position and drone identities; mixed speech/drone recordings do not establish background-only intervals.
sources.access: Metadata and datasheet retrieved; dataset license confirmed in API metadata. Seventeen audio/data ZIPs not transferred.
blockers: Does not fill moving-flight coverage.
No verified negative exposure or audible-event annotations established.
Simultaneous instruments and derived exports must not count as extra time.
sources.next_action: Inspect archive members and paired-device provenance, then measure supported durations. Use as hardware/vehicle variety if accepted.
sources.disposition: candidate; quality, provenance and duplicate review pending

sources.title: NEAPTIDE
sources.coverage: Four drone models; hover, yaw, ascent/descent and translational manoeuvres. Release is segmented and includes propagation/ground corrections.
sources.duration_evidence: Seven distribution files, 176260894 bytes; no measured original elapsed time.
sources.label_support: Manoeuvre/noise-characterization metadata; original field mixtures and negative coverage not established.
sources.access: Metadata retrieved; calibration, documentation and five ZIPs listed. Full data not transferred.
blockers: Noncommercial license must remain visible; do not merge blindly into a general-use product corpus.
Determine whether released WAVs are suitable field inputs after correction/segmentation.
No verified continuous negative exposure.
sources.next_action: Read correction/calibration methodology and original-recording provenance before selecting an experimental role.
sources.disposition: candidate; quality, provenance and duplicate review pending

sources.title: AuDroK original campaigns and aggregation
sources.coverage: One June 7, 2023 Dresden campaign. Main pair: 56 measurement groups, 56 point microphones and 168 mono array means. Including the dual-drone pilot gives 58 point files/2.9407 file-hours; not independent sessions. Seven publisher model codes in the main pair, with incomplete model-name mapping.
sources.duration_evidence: 232 total WAVs represent 11.7628 file-hours across four simultaneous views per named measurement. Individual point microphones total 2.9407 file-hours; audibility, non-overlap and negative exposure are not independently annotated.
sources.label_support: Varies by original source; field, laboratory and collected web recordings must remain distinct.
sources.access: Completed public-source intake observed in shared storage; all five receipts match the plan. Both large outdoor archives have all 224 WAV headers inspected; sampled complete members checked.
blockers: Three views per measurement average 24 microphones; exclude them from the primary single-microphone inputs.
Only one campaign and no reviewed drone-absent intervals; weak recording labels cannot label every crop.
Four publisher drone codes absent from the old table; condition tokens lack a complete temporal annotation mapping.
Complete native-data checks are sampled so far; the 58-file CPU preparation step will validate every selected point member.
sources.next_action: Broaden beyond the audited 2.9407-hour original outdoor point subset: inventory remaining original lab and external-source packages, preserving parentage and source-specific terms. Do not interpret that subset as the complete available corpus.
sources.disposition: candidate; quality, provenance and duplicate review pending

sources.title: RealMAN raw background noise
sources.coverage: Publisher:144.5 hours,31 scenes,32 microphones. Rounded metadata gives28.45 outdoor hours,16.65 semi-outdoor,18.78 transportation and80.53 indoor. These are scenes, not verified independent capture days.
sources.duration_evidence: Pinned scene metadata totals8665 rounded minutes. One native CH0 file decoded as60s/48kHz/PCM16 and verified against its stored RAR member CRC and observed SHA.
sources.label_support: Natural background for auxiliary training/mixing. No independently reviewed drone-absence benchmark labels established. Speech-playback recordings are a separate component and excluded from this candidate.
sources.access: Ungated pinned Hugging Face revision fea47505cae8041f4b652b0954ba61c77d2b6df1;51 noise archives total478593947897 bytes across all microphone channels. Selective stored-member transfer proven for one file only.
blockers: Do not count32 simultaneous channels as separate hours.
Most metadata hours are indoor; outdoor field coverage is smaller.
Negative-only acquisition does not provide matched capture conditions for positive sources.
Only one RAR member/header subset tested; remaining archive layouts and source grouping need inspection.
sources.next_action: Stage a fixed microphone channel per original recording, retain recording IDs and source terms, and use reviewed subsets/labels appropriate to the chosen experimental role.
sources.disposition: candidate; quality, provenance and duplicate review pending

sources.title: DADS drone-audio-detection-samples aggregation
sources.coverage: Card claims27.10 drone hours and33.81 background hours over180320 rows. Contains ground, onboard, fault and reused environmental datasets; mirrors are not independent capture collections.
sources.duration_evidence: Card reports 27.10 drone + 33.81 background = 60.91 file-hours; not independent real field time. Repeated views, mixtures, mirrors and source reuse require reconstruction.
sources.label_support: Audio and binary label schema; origin/session mapping is not provided as separate schema columns. Inspect embedded audio paths before judging whether parentage can be recovered.
sources.access: Public card retrieved; audio Parquet shards not transferred.
blockers: Overlap with DroneNoise,AuDroK,Al-Emadi and already consumed ESC sources.
Onboard/rig/fault data cannot silently fill ground-monitoring hours.
MIT card header does not replace original per-source licensing, which the card itself says to verify.
sources.next_action: Recover a source/parent map before using any subset. Prioritize original ground recordings; assign no fresh-test status to repackaged sources.
sources.disposition: candidate; quality, provenance and duplicate review pending

sources.title: Al-Emadi DroneAudioDataset
sources.license: Custom restricted educational/noncommercial academic license at inspected revision; third-party audio retains separate terms.
sources.coverage: Indoor propeller recordings plus artificial noise augmentation; binary/multiclass layouts reuse identical WAV blobs.
sources.duration_evidence: 23,408 WAV paths but only 10,625 distinct Git WAV blobs; original capture time unresolved. Do not equate augmented clips with independent time.
sources.label_support: Publisher drone classes; unknown includes ESC-50 derivatives, Speech Commands noise and created silence.
sources.access: Full non-truncated Git tree and README inspected; no bulk WAV transfer.
blockers: Original capture/session and augmentation lineage incomplete.
ESC-50 and binary/multiclass duplication must remain linked.
sources.next_action: Retain as an auxiliary indoor/augmentation candidate; reconstruct original-positive parentage before fitting.
sources.disposition: candidate; source role provisional, not accepted study exposure

sources.title: SPCup19 Egonoise Dataset
sources.license: Publisher makes data available for research and education; no uniform standard CC license established.
sources.coverage: Ten team packages of drone-embedded recordings; multiple drone models and 1/4/8/16 microphone channels.
sources.duration_evidence: Unique capture hours not measured; channels and teams are not interchangeable with hours or independent sessions.
sources.label_support: Publisher ego-noise descriptions; individual team documentation linked.
sources.access: Original HTTPS page read successfully with standard HTTP client; package/document links recorded.
blockers: Per-team conditions, original timelines, channel roles and terms need package-level inspection.
sources.next_action: Audit team documents/manifests and use appropriate onboard/mechanism role rather than counting as ground-listening field exposure.

sources.title: DREGON UAV-embedded sound localization
sources.license: Publisher: personal, educational and academic use only.
sources.coverage: Drone-mounted eight-microphone array; room flights with external speech/noise, noise-only flights, individual motors and clean loudspeaker recordings.
sources.duration_evidence: Unique original capture time not measured. Clean, motor-only, mixed and in-flight recordings require separate accounting.
sources.label_support: Source position, motor/IMU logs and audio timestamps; these are not ground-microphone drone-presence annotations.
sources.access: Original HTTPS page read; per-flight audio and log links available.
blockers: Raw extents and conditions not inventoried at member level.
sources.next_action: Inventory noise-only/motor recordings as auxiliary acoustic data and preserve all source/log relationships.

sources.title: Sound-Based Drone Fault Classification Using Multi-Task Learning
sources.coverage: Three drone models, body-mounted microphones, tethered chamber manoeuvres; 0.5-second segments mixed with noise from five campus spots.
sources.duration_evidence: 54,000 mixtures per model with two microphone views; raw independent capture time unresolved. Three TAR files total 7,622,850,560 bytes.
sources.label_support: Publisher fault/direction labels and filename source/background indices; published random mixture split is not adopted.
sources.access: Zenodo API file sizes/checksums and primary paper inspected; no full TAR downloaded.
blockers: Mixtures and parallel microphones repeat underlying captures.
Need base drone/background IDs across publisher splits.
sources.next_action: Inspect TAR directory/filename lineage and retain as auxiliary onboard/fault acoustics, not an independent outdoor ground benchmark.
sources.disposition: candidate; source role provisional, not accepted study exposure

sources.title: UrbanSound8K
sources.license: CC-BY-NC; inspected original description specifies 3.0, soundata has a conflicting 4.0 constant. Preserve source terms/credits.
sources.coverage: 8,732 short foreground-class excerpts from 1,297 Freesound parent IDs; variable native formats.
sources.duration_evidence: CSV sums to 31,504.215497 excerpt seconds (8.7512 h); within-parent interval union is 14,264.203667 seconds (3.9623 h). Metadata time, not reviewed absence.
sources.label_support: Publisher event class and salience; not exhaustive drone-absence annotation.
sources.access: Complete CSV obtained from mirror and exactly MD5-matched to soundata release index; official 6 GB archive route recorded.
blockers: 94 parent IDs shared with ESC-50; some parents cross publisher folds.
Parent file IDs do not establish unique recordists, sessions or sites.
sources.next_action: Acquire original native excerpts plus credits; group by parent including cross-source links, and use as background/confuser supervision.
sources.disposition: candidate; source role provisional, not accepted study exposure

sources.title: ESC-50
sources.license: CC-BY-NC-3.0 for ESC-50; retain per-source credits and distinguish ESC-10 terms.

sources.duration_evidence: 10,000 nominal file seconds (2.7778 h). Original offsets are absent from this CSV, so within-parent unique time is unresolved.
